intro.caverna (1): The elders told us that the world is shaped like a Great Tree. So large that its trunk holds everything that exists.
intro.caverna (2): That in each of its branches inhabits a different tribe, with stories and traditions as unique as they are special.
intro.caverna (3): These branches are so large that they are worshipped as Sacred Trees. Each having a creative power that maintains balance.
intro.caverna (4): They also told us that we were born from the Tree of Life. When its guardians took the elements and used them to create us.
intro.caverna (5): But one day it began to dry up, crack, and break. That's where the adventure began.
intro.caverna (6): And so we have lived for thousands of years, in peace and taking advantage of what the Great Tree gives us,
intro.007 FIN: visiting tribes and investigating how to save each of the Sacred Trees.

introMaya.slide1Text: The Sacred Macaw welcomes you. The Mayan branch has lost its shine and needs a brave seeker to restore its colors.
introMaya.slide2Alt: Macaw pointing toward the mission path
introMaya.slide2Text: Accept the mission, register, and follow the clues to awaken the guardians and save the Sacred Tree.
